title: Low-cost silicon cutting waste reused as a high-power-density silicon-based anode
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34823-34832
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06203E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lanxiang Huang, Jialin Wang, Yu Hu, Chang Chen, Liujun Cao, Qiang Jiang
Low-cost silicon cutting waste was reused as a silicon-based anode by combining it with different mass ratios of graphite. Si20G80 exhibited excellent fast charge–discharge performance and cycling stability.
